purpose.zh: 根基因 ID 到中英文名称的唯一登记表。思维雷达的第一根轴用它显示名称，元数据校验器用它检查游戏声明的 ID 是否存在。ID 只描述能力，位置信息一律走 moduleId / unitId / levelId。
purpose.en: The single registry mapping rootGene ids to bilingual names. Axis 1 of the thinking radar uses it for labels, and the metadata validator uses it to check that ids declared by games actually exist. An id describes ABILITY only; location always travels in moduleId / unitId / levelId.

notes.namingZh: 格式 RG.SCOPE.CATEGORY.NODE，全大写，段内用下划线。
notes.namingEn: Format RG.SCOPE.CATEGORY.NODE, upper case, underscores inside a segment.
notes.unknownZh: 未登记的 ID 不是错误：radar-reader.js 会从 ID 本身推导出显示名，图表当天就能显示；登记只是为了给它一个人话名字。
notes.unknownEn: An unregistered id is not an error: radar-reader.js derives a label from the id itself, so a brand-new gene charts the day it is first reported. Registering it only gives it a human name.
notes.mnZh: 根基因与模块是 M:N 关系。同一个基因可以被多个模块训练，同一个模块也可以声明多个基因。
notes.statusZh: status 缺省为 active。planned 表示这个基因已经被 metadata/game.json 认领，但还没有任何代码上报过它，校验器把它报成 INFO 而不是「死条目」警告。
notes.statusEn: status defaults to active. planned means the gene is already claimed by metadata/game.json but no code reports it yet, so the validator lists it as INFO instead of warning about a dead entry.

RG.LOGIC.COMPARISON.BASIC.descZh: 在共同维度上判断两个或多个对象的大小、多少、顺序与等同。
RG.LOGIC.COMPARISON.BASIC.descEn: Judge relation, order and equivalence among objects on a shared dimension.

RG.LOGIC.REASONING.BASIC.descZh: 由已知条件推出未知结论，包括传递关系与排除法。
RG.LOGIC.REASONING.BASIC.descEn: Derive an unknown conclusion from given facts, including transitivity and elimination.

RG.PATTERN.SEQUENCE.BASIC.descZh: 发现一串元素的重复或递进规则，并据此续写。
RG.PATTERN.SEQUENCE.BASIC.descEn: Find the repeating or progressing rule in a run of elements and continue it.

RG.PATTERN.VISUAL.SIZE.descZh: 以尺寸为线索识别视觉规律。
RG.PATTERN.VISUAL.SIZE.descEn: Read a visual pattern whose cue is size.

RG.PATTERN.VISUAL.COLOR.descZh: 以颜色为线索识别视觉规律。
RG.PATTERN.VISUAL.COLOR.descEn: Read a visual pattern whose cue is color.

RG.PATTERN.VISUAL.SEQUENCE.descZh: 在图形排列中识别顺序规律。
RG.PATTERN.VISUAL.SEQUENCE.descEn: Identify order in an arrangement of shapes.

RG.PATTERN.SPATIAL.RELATION.descZh: 判断上下、左右、内外、相邻等位置关系。
RG.PATTERN.SPATIAL.RELATION.descEn: Judge above/below, left/right, inside/outside and adjacency.

RG.PATTERN.TEMPORAL.SEQUENCE.descZh: 判断事件的先后顺序与因果链条。
RG.PATTERN.TEMPORAL.SEQUENCE.descEn: Order events in time and follow a chain of causes.

RG.PATTERN.MOTION.SEQUENCE.descZh: 从移动、旋转、翻转中提取变化规则。
RG.PATTERN.MOTION.SEQUENCE.descEn: Extract the rule behind movement, rotation or flipping.

RG.PATTERN.QUANTITY.RELATION.descZh: 识别数量之间的增减、倍数与对应关系。
RG.PATTERN.QUANTITY.RELATION.descEn: Recognise increase, multiple and correspondence between quantities.

RG.PATTERN.INTEGRATION.MULTI_DIMENSION.descZh: 同时跟踪两条以上线索，并把它们合起来判断。
RG.PATTERN.INTEGRATION.MULTI_DIMENSION.descEn: Track two or more cues at once and combine them into one judgement.

RG.PATTERN.TRANSFORMATION.RULE.descZh: 看出前一个对象是怎么变成后一个的，并把这条变换用下去：部件增减、组合拆分、属性逐步改变。
RG.PATTERN.TRANSFORMATION.RULE.descEn: See how each object becomes the next one and apply that transformation onward: parts added or removed, assembly and splitting, an attribute changing step by step.
RG.PATTERN.TRANSFORMATION.RULE.boundaryZh: 单符号的朝向旋转（↑→↓←）归小精灵 Visual Pattern，方向加步长的连续移动归 Motion Pattern；本基因只管可数的部件与属性变化。
RG.PATTERN.TRANSFORMATION.RULE.boundaryEn: Rotating a single symbol's heading is MindSeeds Visual Pattern and direction-plus-step movement is Motion Pattern; this gene covers only countable part and attribute changes.

RG.MATH.NUMBER_SENSE.BASIC.descZh: 对数的大小、多少与相对位置形成直觉。
RG.MATH.NUMBER_SENSE.BASIC.descEn: Build intuition for magnitude, quantity and relative position of numbers.

RG.STRATEGY.DECISION.PLANNING.descZh: 在多个可行方案中权衡取舍，并安排先后步骤。
RG.STRATEGY.DECISION.PLANNING.descEn: Weigh several workable options and order the steps between them.

RG.MODELING.EQUATION.RELATION.descZh: 把一个具体情境写成可计算的关系式。
RG.MODELING.EQUATION.RELATION.descEn: Turn a concrete situation into a relation that can be computed.

RG.LOGIC.CLASSIFICATION.BASIC.descZh: 按一条或多条属性把对象归入正确的组别。
RG.LOGIC.CLASSIFICATION.BASIC.descEn: Put objects into the right group by one or more attributes.

RG.ATTENTION.SEARCH.VISUAL.descZh: 在干扰项中持续寻找并确认目标，数量未知时也不放弃。
RG.ATTENTION.SEARCH.VISUAL.descEn: Keep locating and confirming targets among distractors, even when the count is unknown.

RG.LANGUAGE.SEMANTIC.RELATION.descZh: 判断词与词之间的相同、同义与反义关系。
RG.LANGUAGE.SEMANTIC.RELATION.descEn: Judge sameness, synonymy and antonymy between words.
